behavioural_competencies.statement: Has taken a project from an unclear brief to a shipped outcome and can describe the decisions they made when nobody told them what to do.
Has moved a blocking function such as compliance or legal to a decision without holding authority over it, and can describe how they got there.
Has taken an unpredictable team to a predictable delivery cadence and can describe the mechanism they introduced.
Has rewritten a system that was already carrying traffic and can describe how they cut over without an outage.
Has caught a defect in their own work before a customer did and can describe what they changed afterwards.

constraints.cross_border: Singapore candidate data stays in Singapore and is not copied into the India estate.
constraints.data_receivable: The assessment report, the resume and the interview transcript. No raw proctoring footage.
constraints.location_rules: Relocation is supported for Bengaluru and Pune. The Singapore roles cannot be relocated into.
constraints.notice_tolerance: Up to ninety days for a manager, sixty for everyone else.
constraints.retention_period: Eighteen months after the application closes.
constraints.statutory_requirements: Background verification before an offer, and a valid work authorisation for the country of employment.

disqualifiers: Must hold a valid CA licence for the finance controller roles

dossier_preferences.note: Changes emphasis and length. Never what is assessed.

observable_signals: Has taken a project from an unclear brief to a shipped outcome and can describe the decisions they made when nobody told them what to do.
Has moved a blocking function such as compliance or legal to a decision without holding authority over it, and can describe how they got there.
Has taken an unpredictable team to a predictable delivery cadence and can describe the mechanism they introduced.
Has rewritten a system that was already carrying traffic and can describe how they cut over without an outage.
Has caught a defect in their own work before a customer did and can describe what they changed afterwards.

recruiter_context.band_vs_market: We sit at about the sixtieth percentile for engineering and at market for everything else.
recruiter_context.counter_offer_patterns: Counter offers are common from the two largest local competitors and usually arrive after the offer is signed.
recruiter_context.interview_capacity: Two panels per role per week, and that is the real ceiling rather than an aspiration.
recruiter_context.note: Risk register and recruiter context. Never a scoring input, and compensation is never a ranking input (RPN-PHIL-001 §12.4).
recruiter_context.time_to_hire: Forty five days for an engineer and closer to ninety for a manager, measured rather than targeted.
recruiter_context.turnaround_commitments: Feedback within three working days of every stage.

refusals.alternative: Most of these are better modelled as a weighted constraint a candidate can partially satisfy, with the risk stated, rather than as a filter (§12.5).
refusals.reason: Rests on a protected attribute (an age limit). A disqualifier must be lawful and job-related (RPN-PHIL-001 §12.3, §12.4).

risk_probes: Two strong individual contributors we promoted into manager roles stalled when they had to negotiate with a function that did not report to them, and both left within a year.
One senior engineer delivered nothing for a quarter because nobody handed them a defined process, and they never asked for one.

sourcing_hints.note: Ranking prior only. Never decides who is assessed.
sourcing_hints.slate_goals: At least one third of every sourced slate from under-represented groups, measured at sourcing and never at scoring.
sourcing_hints.talent_pools: Engineers who have shipped under an audit regime, and managers who have run a team through a compliance review.
sourcing_hints.target_industries: Payments, banking infrastructure and regulated marketplaces.

tenure_reading: Long tenures read favourably; short ones are worth a question.
